verdict.rationale: Maritime builds agents from GitHub repos, including private ones via the GitHub App, and streams build logs. That implies automation code can be versioned and reviewed in git outside the platform. However, no documentation shows platform-native versioning, deploy history, diff or review of agent or trigger configuration, or rollback to a prior build. Missing for 10: documented deploy/version history, rollback to a previous build or config, review/diff of automation (trigger/config) changes, independent corroboration.
